info.name: Noyo Carrier Carrier Mapped Field Member Snapshot Test Results API
Retrieves a list of Member Snapshot Test Results.

params.name: member_snapshot_test_report_id
params.description: The unique identifier of the member snapshot test report

params.name: page_size
params.description: The max size of each page of results

params.name: offset
params.description: The integer offset at which to start the page. Possible values are 0 to total_records - 1

params.name: status
params.description: Member Snapshot Test Result status to filter by

params.name: employee_id
params.description: Noyo employee UUID to filter Member Snapshot Test Result

items.docs: Returns a list of Member Snapshot Test Results.
